# Workflows and actions

- Preserve the optimized-image cache keyed by OS/assets/config/lockfile and the Chromium/WebKit download cache keyed by OS, browser set, and Playwright version in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- Before changing résumé compilation/publication or site-check skipping, read `.claude/guidance/resume-publication.md`; it owns the publication boundaries and pipeline regression commands.
